title: 皐月賞の後に・私のために☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seiun Sky isn't able to win the first Classic Triple Crown, the Satsuki Sho. A rare look of frustration crosses her face.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her problems are only compounded by her rival, Special Week, who is single-minded in her drive to conquer the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the way home, Seiun Sky receives a call from her grandfather who praises her hard work. It turns out her participation in the Classics has been his dream.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite this, she's kept her composure and remained herself. It's time to prepare for the Japanese Derby, the second race of the Classic Triple Crown.
